description: Shard is where Longhorn stores Shard object.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: ShardSpec defines the desired state of the Longhorn Shard

diskPath.description: DiskPath is the path of the disk that hosts the shard lvol.

diskUUID.description: DiskUUID is the UUID of the disk that hosts the shard lvol.

evictionRequested.description:
EvictionRequested indicates this shard should be relocated to a different node or disk.
Set by the node controller when the shard's node is being drained or its disk is evicted.

nodeID.description: NodeID is the node where this shard's lvol resides and its NVMe-oF target runs.

shardGroupName.description: ShardGroupName is the name of the owning ShardGroup CR. Immutable after creation.

size.description:
Size is the shard lvol size in bytes. Set by the ShardGroup controller at creation time
and used for idempotent reconciliation.

slotIndex.description:
SlotIndex is the zero-based position of this shard in the EC base-bdev array.
Determines the shard's role: indices 0..k-1 are DATA, k..k+m-1 are PARITY.
Immutable after creation.

status.description: ShardStatus defines the observed state of the Longhorn Shard

lastFailureTimestamp.description: LastFailureTimestamp is the RFC3339 timestamp of the most recent shard failure.

ownerID.description: OwnerID is the ID of the node that owns this Shard.

port.description: Port is the NVMe-oF port of the shard's target export.

rebuildProgress.description: RebuildProgress is the rebuild completion percentage (0-100).

replaceTriggered.description:
ReplaceTriggered is set to true after shard replacement has been initiated, to prevent
re-issuing the replace command on subsequent cycles while SPDK advances the slot state.
Cleared when the slot state transitions away from Failed.

role.description:
Role is the EC role of this slot (data or parity). Derived from SlotIndex and the parent
ShardGroup's DataChunks; stored here for informational purposes only.

state.description: State is the health state of this EC shard slot.

storageIP.description:
StorageIP is the IP address of the NVMe-oF target exported by the shard's InstanceManager.
Populated after the shard instance is running.
